selection: All19 already valid common query geometries from completed memory study. No real feature maps, GT, detector, tracker or neural model read/executed. The previous13 tests are not repeated.
math: A constant field must remain the same exact constant under a linear interpolant. Normalized spatial correlation with a wholly constant current patch is undefined and must abstain. If interpolation creates floating-point variation, subsequent scale-invariant normalization can amplify numerical noise. This is an implementation hypothesis, not yet a measured cause of real wrong identities.
synthetic: Reference8channels are deterministic sin/cos fields of eye coordinates. Current maps are exactly constant per channel, .1/.3/1/10 times fixed channel multipliers. Same frozen19 queries and geometry; log every score and interpolation peak-to-peak. No epsilon/variance threshold or fitting.
acceptance: Every constant-current score must be null; any non-null value disproves the implemented invariant. If no failure, no interpolation fix is justified by this probe. If failure, retain it and require an exact constant-preserving expression plus affine-field and real-grid controls before adoption.

literature.role: Lewis NCC equation2: centered constant patch has zero norm; no valid normalized identity evidence.

Official implementation uses Qhull triangles and linear barycentric interpolation; exact partition of unity defines constant reproduction. Current local sampler is inspected directly, not assumed identical to every SciPy version.
